meta.name: muapi-seedance-2
meta.description: Expert Cinema Director skill for Seedance 2.0 (ByteDance) — high-fidelity video generation across Chinese, Global, and VIP tiers. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, first-last-frame, omni reference, character training, omni-reference training, video editing, and watermark removal.

copy.tagline: 用文字或图片生成高质量视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI生成或编辑视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-fidelity videos from text or images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI-powered video generation and editing

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的文字描述或图片生成 4-15 秒的 AI 视频，支持多种模式：文字生视频、图片生视频、首尾帧插值、视频编辑、去水印等。
howto.when: 当你上传图片或视频，并描述想要的画面、动作、镜头时触发。也可直接输入文字描述生成视频。

say.text: 用这张图片生成一段 10 秒的慢镜头视频，镜头缓慢推进。
say.note: Claude 会调用图片生视频功能，生成指定时长的视频。

say.text: 生成一段 15 秒的无人机航拍视频，从高空俯冲至城市屋顶。
say.note: Claude 会调用文字生视频功能，生成符合描述的航拍镜头。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate 4-15 second AI videos from text or images, supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, first-last-frame interpolation, video editing, and watermark removal.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload images/videos and describe the desired scene, action, or camera movement. Also triggered by text-only video descriptions.

say_en.text: Use this image to generate a 10-second slow-motion video with a slow push-in.
say_en.note: Claude will call image-to-video to generate the specified duration.

say_en.text: Generate a 15-second cinematic drone flythrough from high altitude down to a city rooftop.
say_en.note: Claude will call text-to-video to produce the aerial shot.
